faqs.q: How does Valora help my firm reach new clients?
faqs.a: Valora works to put your firm in front of people who are already looking for the kind of advice you give. We do that in three ways: by making your firm easier to find when people ask AI tools and search engines about financial advice, by reaching out directly to people who fit the clients you serve, and by putting your firm's expertise on YouTube.

Answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) are the work of making a firm's expertise easy for AI assistants and AI-powered search to find, read and cite. They are tools we use, alongside outbound outreach and YouTube, to connect your firm with people seeking its services.
No. Results depend on your firm, your market and your competition, and visibility builds over time. Valora does not guarantee clients, search rankings, AI citations or video views.

faqs.q: Who approves what is published or sent for my firm?
faqs.a: Your firm does. Advisory firms are responsible for their own advertising and communications, so nothing should go out under your firm's name without your review.
Plans start at $900 per month. It is month to month, with no long contract. If you prefer to pay annually, you get 12 months for the price of 10. The price depends on the scope of work for your firm.
No long contract. The service runs month to month, so you can stop at the end of any month. An annual option is available at 12 months for the price of 10.
No. Valora is not a registered investment adviser and does not provide investment advice. Valora provides marketing services to advisory firms.
